resources.string: Android port · plays your own copy of the game (version 1.00b)
Import th07.dat and th07.exe first (Game files, below). Without them the game only shows which files are missing.
English text (from your thcrap English patch)

Dialogue, spell card names, endings, the Music Room and the menus as your English patch shows them (%1$d files, imported from the thcrap folder in your game folder). Turn it off for the original Japanese.
Play with the community English patch on the PC? Keep its thcrap folder in the game folder and choose that folder again: the patch\'s files come along, and this turns on.

Copy your own Perfect Cherry Blossom (version 1.00b) to this phone, then choose its folder here, or pick the files themselves. th07.dat and th07.exe are needed; thbgm.dat adds the music. Your PC\'s score.dat (scores and unlocks) and replays (the replay folder) come along too, and so does the English patch if you play with it on the PC (the thcrap folder in the game folder). The files are copied into the app\'s own storage, so you can delete the folder afterwards.
th07.dat, th07.exe, thbgm.dat and the English patch\'s files are deleted from the app\'s storage. Your own copy is not touched; import it again to play.

Play opens the game\'s title screen: choose the difficulty, character and shot there; scores and play data are saved (replays are not ported yet). For testing, a stage can be started directly instead.
Skip the title screen (start the chosen stage directly)
Difficulty (Extra and Phantasm have their own stage)
Practice start (full power from stage 2 on; practice runs start with 8 spare lives)
Touch controls for the game (a Bluetooth or USB gamepad works too).
Drag speed (how far your character moves for your finger\'s travel)
Auto-fire (Shot is always held while you play)
Focus button toggles (tap on, tap off)
Upright play puts the playfield across the whole width with the score below it and the controls underneath.
